payload.title: Holocene Ice Window Increment
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook analyzes Holocene ice core data to study climate variations. It imports data from LiPD files and processes it using various scientific computing libraries. The notebook suppresses warnings for presentation purposes and manually specifies indices of interest in the dataframes. It employs techniques such as mutual information to select parameters for analysis. The outputs include processed datasets and visualizations of climate data.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook focuses on analyzing Holocene ice core data using LiPD files. It imports necessary libraries and suppresses warnings for presentation. Indices of interest are manually specified, and mutual information is used for parameter selection. The analysis results in processed datasets and visualizations.
